item.title: Trump says U.S. won't attack Iran before midterms. And, ICE agent shoots man in NYC
item.description: Trump announced that the U.S. will not attack Iran ahead of the midterms. And, a 28-year-old man is receiving treatment at the hospital after an ICE agent shot him in the neck.

item.title: Why American investors love European defense startups
item.description: As European defense spending takes off, just about half of the funding in Europe's defense tech industry is coming from American investors this year. One reason why: European investment firms have restrictions on how they can invest.

item.title: ChatGPT for Teens has special safeguards. A watchdog group finds most don't work
item.description: A study from Common Sense Media says most safeguards in ChatGPT for Teens failed. The chatbot talks to teens like a friend and doesn't alert parents when users talk about self-harm and suicide.

item.title: Why mailing a ballot close to Election Day may get it rejected for a late postmark
item.description: If you're using the U.S. Postal Service to return a ballot close to Election Day, officials recommend getting it postmarked at a post office to avoid getting caught up in mail processing changes.
